info.name: Have I Been Pwned API v3 Breach Stealerlogsbyemail API
Get all stealer log domains for an email address

params.name: email
params.description: URL-encoded email address to search for stealer logs. Must be on a verified domain in the domain search dashboard.

items.docs: Available on Pro subscriptions. Searches stealer-log data by the full email address captured by an info stealer. The email address must be on a domain already added to the domain search dashboard and successfully verified. The current subscription must include stealer-log access.
